name: aws_fms_policy
description: Creates an AWS Firewall Manager policy that centrally configures and manages firewall rules across accounts and applications in AWS Organizations.

name.name: name
name.description: The friendly name of the AWS Firewall Manager Policy.

exclude_resource_tags.name: exclude_resource_tags
exclude_resource_tags.description: If true, resources with the specified tags are excluded from this policy.

remediation_enabled.name: remediation_enabled
remediation_enabled.description: If true, the policy will automatically remediate compliance violations.

description.name: description
description.description: The description of the AWS Firewall Manager Policy.

delete_all_policy_resources.name: delete_all_policy_resources
delete_all_policy_resources.description: If true, cleans up resources before policy deletion.

delete_unused_fm_managed_resources.name: delete_unused_fm_managed_resources
delete_unused_fm_managed_resources.description: If true, Firewall Manager removes protections from resources that leave the policy scope.

resource_type.name: resource_type
resource_type.description: A resource type to protect. E.g., AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer.

resource_type_list.name: resource_type_list
resource_type_list.description: A list of resource types to protect.
